title: Where is these locations?
content: I'm new to the mall world group here. I wanna list the places I've been that I dont know where are on the map.The endlessmountain with snow covering it and endless stairs to the top, the sledding/ski slope it's different from the endless mountain, the thrift store, nick nack store with a creepy man entity cashier, the hometown street(the road that mimics you're favorite street from you're hometown or somewhere you have been to IRL), cabin up the snowy mountain in the middle of know where(been trapped there), the haunted forest where an evil witch lives(do not ever go), the island that sinks and has a mini town on it(save the people), the skate park that's unreal and huge and is sometimes covered in snow to snowboard it's by the amusement park but I'm not sure what side(super fun), where is the mental hospital that's different from the 12 story hospital with an outdoor pool and tiki towel booth(keep getting abducted and end up there), giant field that's endless that has a war between all creatures(seemed like the word ended and I saw it), the fair grounds where theres horses , tents etc.
